name: IMA_AGENT_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY
purpose: Connect specialist agents/providers to IMA while keeping IMA as the policy, identity, authorization and audit layer.

capabilities.human_boundary: NONE unless source requires human presence
IDENTITY when user presence/liveness/consent is required
ACCOUNTABLE_DECISION when regulated approval is required

delegation_rules: IMA may call a specialist provider only when the capability is available and both provider authorization and user/task authorization are present.
Delegation never transfers legal identity, signature authority, banking authority, or accountable decision authority.
Provider-side human checks are surfaced to the user at the exact step required.
IMA resumes from a verified checkpoint after completion whenever the provider exposes a reliable completion signal.
Credentials and sensitive evidence remain scoped to the minimum task and are not exposed to unrelated agents.
